scope: Extend sealed typed-module-forest interaction to cyclic module graphs by deterministic canonical spanning-forest conditioning only.
discovery: reject shared variable belonging to more than two modules
build module interaction graph and deterministic DFS spanning forest
define cycle-cut variable set as union of shared variables on non-tree edges

capability.work_bound: 2^|C| times sealed forest-DP polynomial work; under |C|<=floor(log2 L), polynomial in L

algorithm: if interaction already forest, delegate to sealed parent forest solver
otherwise compute canonical DFS spanning forest without optimization
reject when union C of non-tree-edge separator variables exceeds budget
enumerate exactly the 2^|C| assignments only after the budget certificate passes
condition all modules on C and remove fixed variables from interaction separators
run exact sealed-style forest DP on every conditioned residual
SAT if any cut assignment yields certified global witness; UNSAT if every cut assignment yields certified forest UNSAT
next_if_fail: preserve exact falsifier and localize cycle-cut mismatch
